tickets.title: Prepare sale-liquidity staging plan
tickets.text: Prepare a sale-liquidity staging plan for Julian Maplesprocket showing how incoming business-sale cash could be separated among immediate household reserves, estimated tax reserves, renovation funds, debt decisions, and staged investment tranches.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the sale-liquidity staging plan by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Prepare preferred-equity rollover review
tickets.text: Prepare a plain-language financial review of the proposed $1.5 million rollover into Copper Firefly Systems preferred equity for Julian Maplesprocket, including liquidity limits, dividend terms, redemption rights, and concentration risk.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that preferred-equity rollover review by 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Prepare CPA sale-tax projection package
tickets.text: Prepare a coordinated tax estimate covering federal, Oregon, basis, installment-payment assumptions, escrow taxation, and shareholder note treatment for Julian Maplesprocket's business sale before large cash-allocation decisions.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the CPA sale-tax projection package by 2025-01-07.

tickets.title: Model shareholder note payoff treatment
tickets.text: Model the $380,000 shareholder note payoff treatment separately from equity proceeds for Julian Maplesprocket so the advisory team and CPA can distinguish repayment cash from taxable sale consideration assumptions.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to model the shareholder note payoff treatment by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Clarify retention bonus pool variance
tickets.text: Clarify the variance in employee retention bonus pool figures between the buyer's schedule and board materials for Julian Maplesprocket's sale of Buttonwood Balloon Components to Copper Firefly Systems, as the difference could affect net proceeds and working-capital adjustments.
tickets.evidence: Clarification of the retention bonus pool variance is needed by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Prepare escrow holdback reserve analysis
tickets.text: Prepare an escrow holdback reserve analysis for Julian Maplesprocket that excludes escrow release proceeds from the liquidity plan, as Julian may not receive the full escrowed amount for an extended period.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the escrow holdback reserve analysis by 2025-01-13.

tickets.title: Verify incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions
tickets.text: Verify incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions with Teacup Comet Bank for Julian Maplesprocket's expected sale proceeds, as the bank previously held a large inbound wire for manual review.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to verify incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions by 2025-01-02.

tickets.title: Obtain final consulting agreement economics
tickets.text: Obtain final consulting agreement economics for Julian Maplesprocket's post-sale arrangement with Copper Firefly Systems, including compensation, expense reimbursement, termination, and noncompete interaction terms that affect post-sale income forecast.
tickets.evidence: Final consulting agreement economics are needed by 2025-01-09.

tickets.title: Prepare post-sale investment policy
tickets.text: Prepare a post-sale investment policy for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket reflecting staged deployment, cash comfort, tax exposure, and fossil-fuel screening preferences, as the business sale will convert much of Julian's net worth from private-company equity into liquid assets.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the post-sale investment policy by 2025-01-22.

tickets.title: Prepare renovation and mortgage reserve modeling
tickets.text: Prepare renovation and mortgage reserve modeling for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket's Portland residence renovation ($900,000-$1.2 million), existing mortgage terms, lake-cabin debt, and desired liquidity floor before deciding how much sale cash can be committed to property spending.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare renovation and mortgage reserve modeling by 2025-01-16.

tickets.title: Review insurance transition after business sale
tickets.text: Review the insurance transition after the business sale for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket, covering changes to reliance on business income, company-owned insurance, disability coverage assumptions, umbrella exposure, and potential personal-liability concerns after the transaction becomes public.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to review the insurance transition after the business sale by 2025-01-15.

tickets.title: Complete estate liquidity and fiduciary review
tickets.text: Complete an estate liquidity and fiduciary review for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket's 2016 estate plan, addressing fiduciary roles, trust funding assumptions, privacy, and whether the plan matches current family circumstances given the anticipated liquidity increase from the business sale.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete an estate liquidity and fiduciary review by 2025-01-17.

tickets.title: Prepare residency and sourcing support file
tickets.text: Prepare a residency and sourcing support file for Julian Maplesprocket's CPA Alma Dewspindle at Silver Marmot Tax Partners, using Julian's 2024 travel calendar, Oregon workdays, and Washington apartment records for the sale-year tax analysis.
tickets.evidence: Julian’s travel calendar, Oregon workdays, and Washington apartment records create a concrete need for a residency and sourcing support file for the CPA’s sale-year tax analysis by 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Prepare charitable funding structure comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a charitable funding structure comparison for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket using the family's usual $75,000 annual giving level, possible appreciated securities, and potential business-sale liquidity for a donor-advised structure or similar charitable giving vehicle.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the charitable funding structure comparison by 2025-01-14.

tickets.title: Prepare updated funds-flow schedule
tickets.text: Prepare an updated funds-flow schedule for Julian Maplesprocket's business sale separating gross consideration, holdbacks, rollover equity, tax reserves, and transaction fees, as the closing-cash reconciliation remains unresolved between the letter of intent and escrow terms.
tickets.evidence: An updated funds-flow schedule is needed to separate gross consideration, holdbacks, rollover equity, tax reserves, and transaction fees by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Obtain equity ledger and option-cancellation records
tickets.text: Obtain the final capitalization table, option-cancellation records, and manager equity acknowledgments for Julian Maplesprocket's sale of Buttonwood Balloon Components to confirm sale proceeds and retained obligations.
tickets.evidence: those equity ledger and option-cancellation records are needed by 2025-01-06.
